answer.reason: Psalm 78 says God did marvellous signs and wonders in the field of Zoan, which is an event of the place beyond the summary.

clauses.english: was where God wrought marvellous signs and wonders before Israel's fathers
clauses.quote: his wonders in the field of Zoan

doubts: EZK 30:14 only foretells fire in Zoan and ISA 19:11,13 and ISA 30:4 speak of its princes, so I left them out as not being events of the place.
